blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — The rain delay didn’t stop Alex Eala from dominating her first Asian Games 2026 match, routing Thailand’s Patcharin Cheapchandej, 6-1, 6-0, in the second round at Indoor Court C in Higashiyama Park Tennis Center. Eala, who received a first-round bye as the top seed of the women’s singles tournament, advanced to the third round scheduled for Monday Eala’s match was initially scheduled on Center Court in view of the fans early Monday, but rain delays have forced the organizers to move all tennis matches indoors.
